changeSet.author: kmarete

preConditions.onFailMessage: Dataset aliases must be unique, non-null integers between 0 and 2147483646 before migration
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dataset WHERE alias IS NULL OR alias < 0 OR alias > 2147483646 OR alias != trunc(alias)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT alias FROM dataset GROUP BY alias HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_aliases)

changeSet.comment: Allocate public dataset aliases with a database sequence. The trigger is a rolling-deployment compatibility mechanism: it replaces aliases supplied by old application instances as well as allocating aliases for new instances that omit the column.
changeSet.sql: LOCK TABLE dataset IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE
SELECT setval( 'dataset_alias_seq', (COALESCE((SELECT MAX(alias) FROM dataset), 0) + 1)::bigint, false )
CREATE TRIGGER dataset_alias_allocate BEFORE INSERT ON dataset FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION allocate_dataset_alias()
ALTER TABLE dataset ADD CONSTRAINT dataset_alias_valid_integer CHECK (alias >= 0 AND alias <= 2147483647 AND alias = trunc(alias))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE dataset DROP CONSTRAINT dataset_alias_valid_integer
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS dataset_alias_allocate ON dataset
